cases.explain: «Мудрая женщина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

cases.explain: «Правдивый свидетель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

cases.explain: «Правдивый свидетель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

cases.explain: «великий разум» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

cases.explain: «Спокойное сердце» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
